## Private vulnerability?

Do not file exploitable vulnerabilities publicly. Use [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for private reporting.

Do not include real secrets, tokens, private server details, screenshots with personal data, private teacher materials, full database dumps, or raw payment credentials.
